title: nakara-oss package capability manifest (oss.json)
description: Declares everything a resource is allowed to do to the server that runs it. `fivem-devkit safety` fails when code does something this file does not declare. Widening any list is a capability change and needs owner review.

resource.description: FiveM resource name (folder name after install)

http.description: hosts/URL prefixes PerformHttpRequest/fetch may reach; ${convar} placeholders allowed

commands.description: command names passed to ExecuteCommand (first word)

registeredCommands.description: commands this resource registers with RegisterCommand

read.description: convar names or prefix* globs read with GetConvar*

server.description: net events the SERVER accepts from clients

client.description: net events the CLIENT accepts from the server
